title: Robot density: South Korea vs the United States

source.name: World Robotics 2025 report (robot density by country)
source.publisher: International Federation of Robotics (IFR), via Supply Chain 247

notes: IFR World Robotics 2025: the United States ranks 8th worldwide at 307 robots per 10,000 manufacturing workers; South Korea ranks 1st at 1,220.
